title: Martial Arts Software Pricing by Student Count (2026)
description: What martial arts school software costs at 25, 50, 100 and 200 active students: Kicksite, Martialytics, Gymdesk, Zen Planner, Spark, sourced.
h1: Martial arts software pricing by student count
body:
Most dojo software charges by active students. This table shows the published monthly price at common headcounts. Payment processing fees are extra and mostly not published. Try your own numbers in our membership revenue calculator.

*Gymdesk: with Gymdesk Payments / with your own processor. Spark's published price is $199/mo after an 8-week trial (see its tool page). Zen Planner publishes only "starting at $99/mo". Checked 2026-10-22; sources on each tool page.

{{table:kicksite,martialytics,gymdesk,zen-planner,spark-membership}}

Costs beyond the subscription

  • Processing: Martialytics says standard Stripe rates with no markup; Gymdesk is $25/mo cheaper with Gymdesk Payments; Kicksite's US partner Basys charges a flat $29/mo plus 2.9% + $0.25 per card transaction (kicksite.com/payment-processing); MASS charges a 2% platform fee.
  • Extra locations: Gymdesk $50-$100/mo each; Martialytics unlimited.
  • Add-ons: Zen Planner branded app $39/mo, website from $99/mo; Gymdesk branded app $100/mo.

Related: best martial arts school software · Martialytics vs Gymdesk · software buying checklist · martial arts tools
faq: How much does martial arts software cost per month?

Published prices we checked run from $49/mo (Kicksite, 0-25 students) to $199/mo (Kicksite 101+, Martialytics 200+, Spark Membership). Gymdesk reaches $240/mo at 151-250 members with your own processor.
What's the cheapest option for 100 students?
Martialytics at $99/mo (51-100 students) or Gymdesk at $100/mo with Gymdesk Payments. Kicksite is $149/mo for 51-100.
Martialytics says leads and inactive students are free. Gymdesk excludes visitors, frozen or cancelled members and prospects. Zen Planner excludes prospects and staff.
No. Processing is charged separately. Martialytics says it charges standard Stripe rates with no markup; most others don't publish their rates.
